resources.string: Finish the current song when time expires (default)
Playback stops after the current song
Play a song first. You can also set the timer while a song is paused.

Pausing playback does not pause the countdown. If playback is paused or still loading when time expires, it stops immediately. Pausing or changing songs while waiting for the current song to finish also stops playback. The timer stops playback without closing the app, and is cancelled if the app process ends.
